name: slashstitch
description: Cross-platform open-source panorama stitcher built on SlashAPP + Rust.
author: slashmad

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/check-package-platform.mjs linux && npm run build:engine:release && npm run stage:engine && npm run build:notices && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-package-platform.mjs win32 && npm run build:engine:release && npm run stage:engine && npm run build:notices && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis portable zip --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/check-package-platform.mjs darwin && npm run build:engine:release && npm run stage:engine && npm run build:notices && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.test:engine: cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml && cargo build --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --bin slashstitch-worker
scripts.pack: npm run build:engine:release && npm run stage:engine && npm run build:notices && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir --publish never
